body.message:
Kindly be informed that we have checked with the building maintenance and management regarding this matter, and they have confirmed that the issue has been resolved. We have also arranged for our team to inspect the unit from our end, and based on our assessment, there is no other source that could be causing such a smell inside the unit.

As an additional gesture, we can send our team tomorrow to carry out a refresh cleaning and place a pleasant scent in the unit.
